messages:
maya: Heads-up — seeing a weird anchor jump on the CLI snippets page. Empty MDX bullet right before a fenced code block is creating a blank slug and breaking fragment links.

anna: Ugh, that one again. If a list item is empty (or has trailing spaces) and the next node is a code fence the slug generator can emit an empty id.

jeff: Repro'd locally. Linkcheck shows: `ERROR: Fragment not found: /docs/cli#` — the fragment is literally `#`.

maya: Minimal repro from the page: 
```
- 
```bash
redwood deploy
```
- next step
```

anna: There it is. Empty list bullet becomes an empty heading anchor in the HTML.

docs-ci: build failed — mkdocs-linkcheck reported 1 broken fragment (exit code 1).

jeff: Quick fix idea: remove stray empty list bullets and trim trailing whitespace in docs. Two commands I used: 
```bash
# delete empty list bullets in MDX files
perl -0777 -pe 's/^\s*-\s*\n//mg' -i docs/**/*.mdx
# trim trailing spaces
git ls-files "docs/**/*.mdx" | xargs sed -i 's/[ \t]*$//'
```

maya: I'll open a tiny PR that removes the empty bullets and adds a lint rule to catch them. Assigning @jeff for CI follow-up.

sam: Also let's add a short note in the migration guide — a couple of older MDX snippets were auto-generated with a stray bullet. Might help customers who copied content.

anna: Agreed. Also consider adding a rule to the mdx/lint GH action that fails on empty list items.

maya: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4589 (includes fixes + lint rule + test snippet).

docs-ci: build started for PR 4589 (mkdocs build + linkcheck).

jeff: Running a local mkdocs build now to sanity check the rendered anchors.

docs-ci: build passed on PR 4589 :tada: linkcheck OK.

maya: Merged the PR. Thanks folks — closing this thread unless anyone sees a regression.

anna: Nice sleuthing, thanks @maya and @jeff.

sam: Good call adding the migration note.

maya: cheers :shipit:
